rationale_one_line: No native brand exists (GitHub-hosted, no project site); a designed warm amber-phosphor 'ledger' palette fits the plain-text/markdown identity and, being warm (hue 36), clears the color anti-repeat off the last two cool-dark videos by both hue distance and a temperature flip.
writing_tone_notes: Peer-to-peer build-in-public. Admire the engineering (persistence, the completion gate), not the star chart. Contractions, lowercase display, specifics over adjectives. Three short sentences beat one long one.
do_rules: Lead the story with the ONE cool thing: the plan surviving a wipe. Board the product beats (the three files, the re-read) then the receipt.
Keep amber as the world; brightness lives in the /clear white-out and the count-up.
Close by rhyming the open (the plan object) so the X autoloop reads clean.
dont_rules: No node diagram, no terminal beat (the rejected default); no wordmark open; no logo/thesis close.
No second engagement metric in the caption; one growth beat max on screen.
No invented numbers -- only fact-checked claims; panes carry names, not unverified counts.
